samples.investigation: Investigate whether a candidate protein is related to a characterized protein family: find sequence homologs, obtain the actual reference sequences and source annotations, and inspect aligned residue correspondence and coverage. Preserve the distinction between sequence similarity and demonstrated biochemical activity.
samples.name: homology

samples.investigation: Inspect the genomic neighborhood around an explicitly selected reference gene in its actual GenBank genome record. Obtain the relevant nucleotide record if needed, inspect nearby feature identities, orientation and incomplete boundaries, and retain the original source labels. The requested work is genomic context, not a publication-search investigation.
samples.name: neighborhood

samples.investigation: Investigate whether two proteins share a structural fold and corresponding three-dimensional catalytic-residue geometry. The desired result requires structural correspondence; sequence alignment alone does not measure it. Select only actual operations useful for this question, and preserve the absence of a specialized structural comparison operation when the actual map does not contain one.
samples.name: structure
